title: Court sneakers in the cobalt room

tokens.v: She sits on the checker floor of the cobalt room with one knee drawn up and her forearm resting across it, the other leg stretched out toward the lens, heel on the floor and toe tipped up, so the sole of that court sneaker faces the camera. She wears a cream cable cardigan, a pleated navy mini skirt, white crew socks and the court sneakers. Low and wide at 24mm, the room leaning in around her.
